name: VideoRefer Suite
description: VideoRefer Suite is a comprehensive benchmark suite designed to advance spatial-temporal object understanding in videos for Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs). It includes a large-scale object-level video instruction dataset (VideoRefer-700K), a spatial-temporal object encoder model, and a benchmark (VideoRefer-Bench) to evaluate fine-grained spatial-temporal video understanding capabilities.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark suite that has gained attention in the video-LLM community for fine-grained spatial-temporal understanding, but it is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Includes a large-scale object-level video instruction dataset and a benchmark to assess spatial-temporal understanding of Video LLMs.
